_comment_purpose: High-level v2 workflow definition. This file intentionally does NOT contain model ids, tool names, prompt text, or reviewer-swarm configuration. It only references catalog entries by id. Brain orchestration is constrained to meta.activeAgents.
_comment_catalog_files: All concrete model ids, tool lists, prompt packs, and quality gates live in catalog files. v2 runtime consumes these catalog references via the resolved workflow graph.
_comment_reviewer_swarm: Reviewer-swarm goals live in the quality-gates catalog and are attached to the reviewer agent via `agentCatalog.agents[reviewer-default].qualityGates`; the resolver derives the swarm identity from resolved reviewer quality gates whose catalog gate has `kind: review-goal`.

meta.name: default-pi-workflow
meta.description: Default three-agent flow: brain orchestrates, coder implements, reviewer reviews with a goal-aligned reviewer swarm.
